Ishtar Punjabi brings you the superhit Punjabi track “Insane” sung and composed by Sukhe Muzical Doctorz, penned by the lyrical genius Jaani, and directed by the ace Punjabi filmmaker Arvindr Khaira. Produced by Gunbir Singh Sidhu and Manmord Sidhu in association with Yogesh Dixit, this track became a 2017–2018 chartbuster, making waves across Spotify, Apple Music, Gaana, JioSaavn, Wynk, Amazon Music and YouTube.
